source_record_subset.mysql: SELECT `t1`.`name` FROM `league` AS `t1` INNER JOIN `match` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`id` = `t2`.`league_id` WHERE `t2`.`season` = '2009/2010' GROUP BY `t1`.`name` HAVING ( CAST( SUM( `t2`.`home_team_goal` ) AS DOUBLE ) / COUNT( DISTINCT `t2`.`id` ) ) - ( CAST( SUM( `t2`.`away_team_goal` ) AS DOUBLE ) / COUNT( DISTINCT `t2`.`id` ) ) > 0
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT "t1"."name" FROM "league" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "match" AS "t2" ON "t1"."id" = "t2"."league_id" WHERE "t2"."season" = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "t1"."name" HAVING ( CAST( SUM( "t2"."home_team_goal" ) AS FLOAT8 ) / COUNT( DISTINCT "t2"."id" ) ) - ( CAST( SUM( "t2"."away_team_goal" ) AS FLOAT8 ) / COUNT( DISTINCT "t2"."id" ) ) > 0
